title: fix(spec): the Permission Set, Position and view form help texts Setup shows are plain admin copy
body:
Fixes #23853

Clause-②: no

## What changed

Six help texts an administrator reads in Setup carried ADR numbers. Each one is now plain admin copy. The ADR reference moved to the comment beside the form row, the shape of #23817.

| Form leaf | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `permission` · `isDefault` | App baseline for the everyone position (ADR-0090 D5): an app-level set is auto-bound at boot; a package-level set becomes an install-time suggestion an admin confirms. Default false. | Gives this set to everyone who signs in, through the built-in everyone position. A set the app itself declares is granted at startup; a set from an installed package becomes a suggestion an admin confirms in Setup. A set with high-privilege permissions is never granted this way. Default false. |
| `permission` · `managedBy` | Record provenance (ADR-0086 D3): who owns this set across upgrades. | Who owns this set: Package means it ships with a package and package upgrades update it; Platform and User mean it was created in this environment and upgrades leave it alone. |
| `permission` · `packageId` | Owning package id for a package-shipped set (ADR-0086 D3). Leave empty for an environment-authored set. | The package that ships this set; a value naming any other package is refused. Leave empty for a set created in this environment. |
| `permission` · `adminScope` | Delegated administration (ADR-0090 D12): lets holders ... | Delegated administration: lets holders ... (rest unchanged) |
| `position` · `delegatable` | Holders may delegate this position themselves, time-boxed and with a reason (ADR-0091 D3). Default false — delegation is admin-only. | The same sentence without "(ADR-0091 D3)". |
| `view` · section `end_user_controls` description | What end users can do on this view — quick filters, filter tabs, visualization switching (ADR-0047, Airtable Interface parity). | What end users can do on this view — quick filters, filter tabs, visualization switching. |

### Each sentence checked against the code that honours the field

- `isDefault`: `PermissionSetSchema.isDefault`'s docblock and `plugin-security`'s `builtin-positions.ts`. An app-level set is auto-bound to the `everyone` position at boot. Every authenticated member holds that position implicitly. A package-level set materializes a `sys_audience_binding_suggestion` that an admin confirms in Setup. A high-privilege set cannot be bound to the anchor.
- `managedBy`: `package` rows are re-seeded on upgrade. `platform` and `user` rows are environment config that package seeding never touches.
- `packageId`: a value that disagrees with the package that ships the set, or that the set is saved into, is refused at every door (`judgePermissionSetOwnerBinding`). That includes any value on a set no package ships.
- `adminScope` and `delegatable`: the rest of each text was already operational, and #23488 aligned the `adminScope` keys with the live schema. Only the ADR prefix moved.
- The view's end-user controls: the `userFilters` `tabs` element (`view.zod.ts`) and `appearance.allowedVisualizations` are live keys, so "filter tabs" and "visualization switching" stay. The retired `tabs` repeater is not named.

### Translations

- `pnpm i18n:extract` regenerated `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`: 6 leaves.
- The zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES values for the same 6 leaves were hand-written translations of the old wording, and merge mode keeps them. So they were rewritten in place to the new meaning, before the extract. Values only: no key was added or removed.
- The `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` tables did not change. "Setup" stays untranslated, as the sibling leaves in each locale already leave it.

### Test

`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-copy-vocabulary.test.ts` gains two cases. No assertion was deleted.

- **Bright leg:** across all four `metadataForms` bundles, each of the six leaves must be a string (the population cannot shrink) and must carry no ADR number, no decision id (D plus digits), no `finding F`, no `emit()` and no `kernel`. It uses the matcher this file already uses.
- **Dark leg:** the same walk over the replaced prose names all six leaves.

The file docblock's population item 3 names the six leaves.

No other test pins these strings. `git grep` for the old wording hits only `.describe()` text, `content/docs/references/` and changesets, all outside this card.

### Changeset

`.changeset/23853-form-help-texts-plain.md` is a `patch` for `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/platform-objects`, with `Clause-②: no`. No key, type, schema or accept/refuse result changes.

## Verification (head `01167a02`)

- Ablation, one leg, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. "（ADR-0090 D12）" was put back into the zh-CN `adminScope` leaf. The zh-CN case went red, naming `zh-CN.metadataForms.permission.fields.adminScope.helpText (an ADR number, a decision id)`. The restore left the blob equal to HEAD (`48bc7f4d7c85`) and `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 71 files, 1108 tests passed. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, then `check:generated`: exit 0, all 14 generated artifacts up to date.
- `pnpm check:i18n`: exit 0, 10 packages in sync. The first run exited 3 because the extract closure was not built (a prerequisite, not a finding). It passed after the closure the gate names was built.
- `pnpm check:i18n-stale-fill`: exit 0, 0 stale fills.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 86 families. 84 exited 0. 2 exited 3 on prerequisites and are NOT MEASURED locally, left to CI:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: shallow clone.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: not every package is built.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 86 accounted for, 0 UNRUN.
- `main` was merged at `0af559e8` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`. The incoming commits touch none of these files and no generated artifact, so there was nothing to regenerate.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's acceptance holds: none of the six strings contains `ADR-`, a decision id, `finding F`, `emit()` or `kernel`, in source or in any locale. The `en` and locale files are regenerated.
- The full stops match the sibling help texts in each file. Every rewritten text already ended with one, and so does the sibling section description `Chart-specific configuration.`
- The `managedBy` option labels ("Package (upgrade-owned metadata)", "Platform (environment config)", "User (environment config)") carry no ADR vocabulary and are outside this card's file surface. They are unchanged.
- #23829's `domain:services` object descriptions are not addressed here. PR #23846 regenerates the same `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts` files; whichever PR lands second merges `main` and regenerates.
